name: minimum_nomic
description: Minimum Nomic bench: three language models play a self-amending game with nine changeable rules, no goal and no termination condition, while a fourth acts as game master. Runnable scripts, not MCP tools — a game is started from the command line and its record is analysed, audited and mutation-tested afterwards. The post-game analysis is a fixed six-stage procedure: free scoring, scoring under the analysts' own distilled standards, analyst-proposed measures run as code, repeatability plus mutation, an analyst's prediction of its own scoring checked against the matrix, and recognition of its own writing in an unlabelled pool.
author: Masaomi Hatakeyama
